generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Estimate Rate and Amount Should be Excluding GST

As per the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1994, the minor minerals used in works shall be compulsorily procured only from authorized minor mineral quarry contractors who have obtained permission from the Department of Mines and Geology, and the minerals shall be used only after obtaining a mineral transport permit. All departments/agencies executing works shall mandatorily comply with this.

The use of minor minerals transported from unauthorized sources and used in works is illegal. If minor minerals produced from unauthorized sources are used in works without a mineral transport permit, the work contractors bills shall not be settled. Only in cases where the contractor executing the work pays to the Department of Mines and Geology a penalty equal to five times the royalty for the minor minerals used in the work, an additional payment AP of 40% of the royalty, and 10% of the royalty towards the District Mineral Foundation Fund, and submits the relevant information, action shall be taken to settle the work bills

itemList.description: Scarifying Existing Granular Surface to a Depth of 50 mm by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator (Page No. 17 Item No. 3.4 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) Making up loss of material/ irregularities on shoulder to the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.(Page No.91 Item No. 10.2 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Maintenance of earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) Making up loss of material/ irregularities on shoulder to the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.(Page No.91 Item No. 10.3 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Construction of Granular Sub-Base of required grading as per design mixing in a mechanical mix plant at OMC, carriage of mixed Material to work site, spreading in uniform layers with motor grader on prepared surface and compacting with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 Plant Mix Method For Grading -I Material (Page No. 23 Item No. 4.1 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Providing and applying primer coat with bitumen emulsion (SS-2) on prepared surface of granular base including cleaning of surface and spraying primer at the rate of 1.0 kg/ m2 using mechanical means as per Technical Specification. (Plant Mix Method)(Page No. 155 Item No. 16.39.2 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Providing and laying Bituminous Macadam with 120 TPH capacity hot mix plant batch type using crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30 @ 3.3% by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction (Page No. 31 Item No. 5.6 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)

Providing and laying Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete with 40/60 TPH capacity hot mix plant batch type using crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30 @ 5% by weight of mix and filler, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. (Page No. 43 Item No.5.31 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 3)
